inputs.prompt: Vertical mobile game background, portrait 9:19.5 composition. A vast sci-fi void of deep navy blue fading to near-black at the edges. In the upper third, a huge circular holographic array made of thin glowing electric-cyan concentric rings and delicate arc segments floats in darkness like a high-tech summoning circle seen face-on, its center left empty. Far below, a barely visible holographic floor of thin cyan grid lines recedes toward a glowing horizon line, with soft volumetric cyan light falling from high above onto an empty central stage. Fine luminous particles and small cyan bokeh drift through the air; faint hexagonal data patterns and subtle scanlines dissolve into the darkness; thin wisps of fog catch the light near the floor. Clean empty center, soft vignette, very dark and low contrast so bright user-interface text stays readable. Cinematic lighting, ultra-detailed polished digital art, premium sci-fi game UI key visual. No people, no characters, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no logo.
